name: officefc
description: OfficeFC — an Expo and Firebase app for office EA Sports FC leagues, ELO ratings, and confirmed match tracking.

scripts.test: npm --prefix functions run build && node --test test/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.test.json --only firestore,storage "npm --prefix test/rules test"
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run version:check && npm run typecheck:mobile && npm run build:web && npm run test:functions && npm run test:mobile && npm test && npm run test:rules
scripts.deploy:web: npm run build:web && firebase deploy --project office-fc --only hosting
scripts.deploy:backend: npm run validate:web-env && firebase deploy --project office-fc --only firestore,storage,functions
scripts.deploy:mvp: npm run build:web && firebase deploy --project office-fc --only firestore,storage,functions,hosting
